judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The pompous mayor ('died in defense of Nox's vital interests!'), '!?', the digit in 'Rescue the 6 trapped mine workers', 'Charm or kill' and the pushy one-line shopkeeper all match the conjurer campaign's mines chapter; the townsfolk barks are terse and slightly odd in the way Westwood's were.
